newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industry survey shows rising investment.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industry survey shows rising investment.

text.p: Most Argentine companies expect to increase their investments in the coming months, although they see demand for their products largely unchanged in October, according to a government survey released Tuesday.
The monthly poll of industrial expectations in September showed most companies (59.7 percent) forecast increasing investment in the fourth quarter of the year.
Of those, 37.5 percent said the rise in investment would be aimed at increasing production. Some 40.3 percent responded that they did not expect to raise investment in the fourth quarter.

However, according to the poll, 68.3 percent of the companies expected no change in domestic demand for their products in October compared with the previous month, while 20.6 percent expected higher demand and 11.1 percent saw a decline.
Regarding exports, 29.3 percent expected rising shipments, 10.3 percent forecast declines, and the remainder saw no change.
Meanwhile, 25 percent of the respondents said they would need more credit in October compared with the previous month, 10 percent saw falling credit requirements and 65 percent expected no change.
The study found 65.5 percent expected no changes to their stock levels in the fourth quarter, 24.2 percent expected a drop and 10.3 percent expected rising stock inventories.
